Ticket.Title: Add CSV export endpoint for saved report filters
Ticket.Description: Adds POST /api/export, which renders a saved report to CSV by shelling out to the existing report tool. The filter string from the request is passed straight through to the command line. Acceptance: the endpoint returns a CSV attachment for a valid filter.

Comments.Author: programmer
Comments.Body: Delivered. Changed files: src/Api/ExportController.cs, src/Api/Routing/ApiRoutes.cs. The filter is forwarded verbatim so the report tool can parse its own syntax.

Comments.Author: producer
Comments.Body: Label is `code`. This is the first endpoint that runs an external process, so give it a careful look.
